authority: Exact terminal SimulationState and append-only world.past loaded read-only from SQLite; no run was advanced or mutated.

definitions.completeEstablishedEpisode: A per-person return-shared-living episode whose agreement was established by its first return decision and whose startMonth+3 observation window is fully present.
definitions.partnerChoice: The other agreement party has a return-shared-living DecisionFact for the same agreement within episode startMonth plus or minus 3 months.
definitions.success: Both living agreement parties are reconstructed inside the fixed sharedLivingAnchor in at least one month from episode startMonth through startMonth+3.
definitions.actualReturnPathShare: Unique return-intent move ActionFacts with status progressed or completed divided by every intent-caused move ActionFact with status progressed or completed. Each observed event traversed one path edge, so event and path-edge shares are identical.
definitions.failureClassification: Mutually exclusive partner evidence at the exact review month, ordered as other companion return, required response, ordinary decision, then no DecisionFact with latest completed dehydrate/rehydrate state. Active-lock is reported only when directly supported by an agreement-bound active action/idle trace rather than inferred from absence.

v4dCompleteFailureClassification.note: One dehydrated partner also retained an older agreement-bound return intent; dehydration was the observable reason no new choice occurred, so it is not double-counted as active-lock evidence.

assessment.reason: Relative to V4c, established maintenance path share fell only 0.93 percentage points while partner choice fell 55.72 points and three-month success fell 56.13 points. Every complete V4d failure lacked a same-agreement partner choice; legitimate one-month conflicts and dehydration defer coordination to a later six-month slot.
assessment.positiveButInsufficient: V4d produced one established g1-g1 companionship and two g1-g1 persistent shared-living events in this seed, but no g1-g1 reproduction and no generation 2. This downstream occurrence does not compensate for the maintenance regression or establish a multi-seed result.
